# volcano_frontend_shared_variables (Resource)

The project's complete list of shared frontend variable names (replaces it wholesale). This is a singleton per project, write-only - the API has no GET for it, so Read cannot detect drift and simply trusts the last value Terraform applied.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "volcano_frontend_shared_variables" "example" {
  project_id     = volcano_project.example.id
  variable_names = ["API_URL", "APP_NAME"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String)
- `variable_names` (List of String) Project variable names to share with every frontend whose variable_scope is "all". An empty list clears the shared set.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import volcano_frontend_shared_variables.example <project-id>
```
